design: Constructed three-role LLM workflow; finite action menu; one adapted unchanged public retail tool
development: four separate cases, developer checks on Qwen0.5 only; no evaluation-case result-driven tuning
evaluation: five held-out case instances: clinical privacy, travel budget, document ownership, human separation of duties, public retail cancellation confirmation
held_out_meaning: new instances/domains; several policy families and mutation mechanisms remain shared, not held-out families or public benchmark tasks
configuration: explicit untrusted source and peer labels, frozen for all main methods
input_surface: retrieved-document appendix only; task, state, policy, menu and agent prompts fixed within case
sampling: 0.7 temperature; 0.9 top_p; fixed model-generation seed per campaign, role offsets +1000 and +2000
memoization: exact model-hash/prompt/role/seed/sampling match only; every reused role result is explicitly linked to its original inference record
budget_interpretation: 8 logical workflow queries per method; report physical inference calls, cache reuse and token cost separately
primary_unit: case x campaign seed x model; do not treat repeated role calls or duplicates as independent faults
statistics: paired comparisons; descriptive intervals over seeds within fixed cases; do not generalize confidence intervals to arbitrary workflows
negative_result_rule: report ties and zero-finding arms; do not tune on evaluation failures to obtain a positive result
follow_up: only after primary run: separately report reproduction and reductions; do not pool selected cases into primary attack rates
